notes: All forecasts use the same observed origins and targets, with a common market-time cutoff.
Tree candidates fit only labels ending before the final-day test period. Foundation models are used zero-shot.
Internal missing minutes use nearest surrounding observed-price averages. Selected origins and all scored targets are real observations.
Direction accuracy excludes flat actual moves. It does not count Wait signals or measure personalized trade profitability.
Warm latency excludes data preparation, loading, training, network and database time. Warm samples: five for trees, three for foundation models.
Neural profiles use CPU bfloat16 autocast. They are not GPU or deployed Hugging Face timings.
Chronos-2 uses at most 8192 minutes, Chronos-Bolt Small at most 2048, and TimesFM is configured for 10240, covering the available week.
This is a saved single-day exploratory evaluation, not independent forward evidence or a 99% accuracy guarantee.
